I farm in Afar where the rain is not reliable, so on this sorghum plot I keep costs low and use what I can manage with my household. I will plant my local seed, use some manure if I have enough, and depend on family work with no irrigation. I do not want to spend on chemical fertilizer or pesticide for this small plot, and I will not hire workers unless there is a big problem.
